decisions.source_name: Proposed accepted-name assignment: Festuca texana Vasey
decisions.reason: The 1886 Vasey name is an illegitimate later homonym, not the accepted name for the learner. FAIL applies to the unsafe accepted-name proposal, not to the plant identity.

decisions.source_name: Existing Festuca versuta learner photograph and historical plate
decisions.reason: The current canonical card documents loose fragments and a historical botanical plate, not an independently vouchered complete living specimen. Taxonomic synonymy cannot authenticate its exact image or justify overriding a previous misidentified-plate exclusion.

decisions.source_name: Existing Festuca octoflora learner photographs, including possible historical variety forms
decisions.reason: Accepted species mapping does not certify the source image as any particular historical variety or verify its visible characters; retain existing provisional photo-science flags.

decisions.source_name: Historical Vulpia octoflora varieties glauca, hirtella and tenella
decisions.reason: POWO synonymizes varieties under Festuca octoflora, whereas Flora of North America / regional floras recognize infraspecific concepts and note overlap in characters; a source voucher cannot be assigned a precise variety without morphological evidence.

POWO documents Festuca texana Vasey as illegitimate later homonym under F. versuta, but an authorless historical label is not sufficient to select a nomenclatural concept. Do not auto-map ambiguous records.

limitations: POWO/WCVP accepted-name mappings do not verify the learner's photographed specimens.
Alternative Vulpia infraspecific treatments are documented but no individual source-voucher variety identity is asserted.
The earlier homonym that invalidates Festuca texana Vasey was not independently protologue-checked; no identity was assigned to authorless labels.
No evidence here justifies a hybrid designation or parentage for either canonical species.
No county nativity audit, media, learner card, lesson, installation, or website changes.
